732580101.text: "... So Arama decides to write things down like Nara does. Although Arama does not easily forget things like Nara does, or can't share memories as Nara, it is also very interesting."

732580202.text: #"...Arama feels happy for the knowledge Paimon taught me. The spell turned out to be Treasure rather than Tracer. Nara {NICKNAME} defeated Vanagni effortlessly. So amazing..."

732580203.text: "...Everybody loves them. The golden one is like a big sun and the silver one is like a little moon, gentle and bright..."

732580302.text: #"... Arama has prepared flowers, but Arama is afraid that Arama can't give the flowers to {M#him}{F#her}. However, fear is not good, as Arana said, if you are afraid, you will believe in the power of fear..."

732580303.text: "...Festival Utsava is about to begin. Many friends Arama hasn't seen for a long time have returned to Vanarana. Araja is also happy to be able to fill the vacancy for him. "

732580402.text: #"...it looks so good with a garland, and it connects you with everyone. Just like {M#he}{F#she} is an Aranara too."

732580403.text: #"Now Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are resting. I still don't understand. Why does Nara have to rest? You can't create memories with your friends while taking a break..."

732580404.text: #"... Going to meet Ashvattha. Ashvattha will accept Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. We are all children of the forest."

732580405.text: #"By the way, there must be a lot of adventure stories about Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon and everyone in Aranyaka."

732580406.text: #"After Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon get the Bija and help Narana, let's call Arana and read the stories in aranyaka!"
